correctness.rationale: In the spin-one Cartesian basis sum_a J_a X J_a=Tr(X)I-X^T, giving the completely positive interpolation E_p=(1-p)id+p(Tr(.)I-(.)^T)/2 on 0<=p<=1. The normalized Choi matrix is J_p=(1-p)P_Phi+p(I-F)/6; partial transpose is ((1-p)/3)F+(p/6)(I-3P_Phi). Three mutually orthogonal subspaces antisymmetric (dim3), entangled line (dim1), and symmetric tracefree (dim5) have eigenvalues (3p-2)/6, (1-2p)/3, (2-p)/6, respectively. Sign changes at p=1/2 and 2/3 yield exact negativity 1-3p/2, (4-5p)/6, (2p-1)/3 over consecutive intervals; the negative intervals cover all p and slopes -3/2,-5/6,+2/3 force unique minimum N=1/9 at p=2/3, N(1)=1/3. Independently verified exact rational 9x9 Choi matrices, partial transpose and projector decompositions symbolically and checked rational phase boundaries. No capacity or higher-dimensional inference is asserted.
